title: Constraint Enforcement
text: Modify control actions to satisfy constraints and action bounds, 6 inputs, 2 outputs, {Constraint bound} sets Constraint bounds; {Number of constraints}, {Number of actions}, {Use external source} adds external constraint bound input port, {Use external source for upper bound} adds upper action bound input port, {Use external source for lower bound} adds lower action bound input port, {Sample time} sets the optimization sample time, {Maximum iterations} sets the maximum optimization iterations, {Constraint tolerance} sets the tolerance for constraint, {Optimization status} adds exit flag output port, {Ignore constraints when QP is infeasible} sets the disable constraints when optimization and {Ignore action bounds when QP is infeasible} sets the disable action bounds when optimization. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: fx
ports.summary: Constraint function offset coefficient scalar | vector

ports.name: gx
ports.summary: Constraint function linear coefficient scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: umax
ports.summary: Action signal upper bounds scalar | vector

ports.name: umin
ports.summary: Action signal lower bounds scalar | vector

params.name: Use external source
params.values: Add external constraint bound input port off (default) | on

params.values: Add upper action bound input port off (default) | on

params.name: Use external source for lower bound
params.values: Add lower action bound input port off (default) | on

params.name: Constraint tolerance

params.name: Optimization status
params.values: Add exit flag output port off (default) | on

params.values: Disable action bounds when optimization is infeasible off (default) | on
